name: tatami-explainer
description: Visual reader for the Tatami pipeline and its Lean proofs.

scripts.extract: python3 scripts/extract-graph.py && python3 scripts/extract-types.py && cp scripts/corpus.json src/data/corpus.json && (cd .. && lake env lean --run explainer/scripts/Stages.lean explainer/scripts/corpus.json) > src/data/stages.json
